full_name: Martha Ann Selby | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2004–2005 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow The University of Texas at Austin
bio: Martha Ann Selby is an associate professor of South Asian studies in the Department of Asian Studies at the University of Texas at Austin, where she teaches courses on Indian literature, Hindu and Buddhist religions, history of Indian medicine, and gender formations in the classical and modern periods.
